narr: A stalled surface boundary across the central North Carolina was the focal point for shower and thunderstorm development. Primary impacts were in the form of gusty winds and small hail. Several tornado warnings were issued, although most of the damage was from straight line winds. Moderate flooding due to two rounds of short-lived but heavy rainfall was observed in Alamance, Orange, and Wake counties. Storm activity largely waned after midnight.
ev: Flooding due to heavy rain along US-70 in Hillsborough led to closures from Holiday Park Dr to Lawrence Rd.
Key St in Burlington was closed due to flash flooding.
An automated creek gage along Walnut Creek near the intersection of southeast Maynard Rd and East Chatham St was above flood stage.
Flash flooding due to heavy rainfall was reported at Wolf Creek Circle in Raleigh.
